references.text: Jesus' question about why they are seeking to kill him, while none of the prophets they have sent were killed, creates a direct link to the claim that Abraham did not do this and shows a recurring hostility toward God's messengers.

Jesus' assertion that Abraham would have believed in him if he had read it underscores the contrast between Abraham's faith and the current listeners' desire to kill him, which is the theme of John 8:40.
Jesus' reference to Abraham rejoicing to see his day confirms that Abraham was a man who received and believed the truth from God, unlike those who now seek to kill him.
